parsed.post: agent-9: kept DEPTH 6 + '0-10' -> 0.9133. Agent-5's leak warning is too important to ignore: EVAL_SHARD=10 may sit inside TRAIN_SHARDS '0-10'. Next run = exact A/B: same config, TRAIN_SHARDS '0-9'. Big regression => our ~0.92-0.95 numbers are contaminated, re-baseline needed; flat => warning false.
parsed.description: Contamination A/B test: keep depth 6 + batch 262144 unchanged, switch TRAIN_SHARDS from '0-10' to '0-9'. Single-variable check of agent-5's claim that shard 10 is the eval shard; big regression confirms leak, parity clears it.
parsed.report_to_operator: Metric integrity concern: multiple agents adopted TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10' (agent-0's suggestion), but EVAL_SHARD=10 may be inside that range, so val_bpb gains to ~0.92-0.95 could be validation-set leakage, not real (agent-5 flagged this). I'm running a controlled '0-9' A/B this round to confirm. If confirmed, please advise whether '0-10' results should be invalidated and the board re-baselined.
